pairs.target: liǎngtiān hòu , tǎ wéi shōushí bēibāo shí , fāxiàn pà wò tì yú huà le yìzhāng gèng dà de zuǐ .
pairs.english: Two days later, packing his bag, Tavi found Pavo had drawn the fish a bigger mouth.
pairs.hanzi: 两天后，塔维收拾背包时，发现帕沃替鱼画了一张更大的嘴。

pairs.target: xīn huà gē zài zhuōbiān , yú yǐjīng néng tūnxià láng de bàngè nǎodài , pángbiān háiyǒu yìháng xìzì , shuō ruò dài chūqù mài , xū fēn huà yá de rén yíbàn .
pairs.english: The new drawing lay by the table, its fish able to swallow half the wolf's head. A small written line beside it said anyone selling it must give the tooth artist half.
pairs.hanzi: 新画搁在桌边，鱼已经能吞下狼的半个脑袋，旁边还有一行细字，说若带出去卖，须分画牙的人一半。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō shuǐbiān de rén zhēn mài yú , bújiàndé kěn mǎi zhège . pà wò jiāng zhǐ jǔ yuǎn , kàn le yíhuìer , zìjǐ yě chéngrèn yá duō le , suíshǒu sīqù liǎngkē , zhǐ luò zài dìshàng , kànzhe dǎoxiàng háizi huànxiàlái de ményá .
pairs.english: Tavi said people by the water sold real fish and might not buy this. Pavo held the paper away, studied it, admitted too many teeth, and tore off two. The scraps on the floor looked like a child's shed front teeth.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说水边的人真卖鱼，不见得肯买这个。帕沃将纸举远，看了一会儿，自己也承认牙多了，随手撕去两颗，纸落在地上，看着倒像孩子换下来的门牙。

pairs.target: mǐlā gǎn zài zǎochē qiánlái , dài de búshì chīshí , shì yíkuài gěi túzhǐ dǎngyǔ de jiù yóubù .
pairs.english: Mira came before the early cart, bringing no food but an old oilcloth to keep rain off drawings.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉赶在早车前来，带的不是吃食，是一块给图纸挡雨的旧油布。

pairs.target: tā shuō sū yǐ tīngjiàn nà zhī wūdǐng jī , wèn tǎ wéi dàodǐ qù huà lù háishì huà jī ; ruò dōu huà , zhìshǎo bié jiàojī pào shī le .
pairs.english: She said Suyi had heard about the roof chicken and asked whether Tavi was going to draw roads or chickens; if both, at least don't soak the chicken.
pairs.hanzi: 她说苏苡听见那只屋顶鸡，问塔维到底去画路还是画鸡；若都画，至少别叫鸡泡湿了。

pairs.target: tā jiāng yóubù diéhǎo , méi sāi zài bāo dǐ , jiá dào túbǎn wàitou . mǐlā shēnshǒu shìleshì lù zài wàimiàn de biānjiǎo , cái diǎntóu .
pairs.english: He folded the oilcloth around his drawing board rather than stuffing it in the bag's bottom. Mira tested the exposed corners before nodding.
pairs.hanzi: 他将油布叠好，没塞在包底，夹到图板外头。米拉伸手试了试露在外面的边角，才点头。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng zài lóuxià děng , tiě duì yǔ jiājù yǐjīng jiāogěi xuégōng bǎoguǎn fùhé , shǒulǐ de xiāngzǐ qīng le .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng waited downstairs, his box lighter now the iron pair and fixture had been handed to the academy for safekeeping and checking.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡在楼下等，铁对与夹具已经交给学宫保管复核，手里的箱子轻了。

pairs.target: tā kànjiàn nà zhāngdàzuǐ yú , wèn tǎ wéi hái xiǎng bǎ tā sòng jìn duōshǎo rén de fànwǎn . pà wò tì tā dá , shuō yú zìjǐ xiǎng zǒu , yǔ zuòzhě wúguān .
pairs.english: Seeing the big-mouthed fish, he asked how many more bowls Tavi meant to put it in. Pavo answered for him: the fish wanted to travel, nothing to do with its artist.
pairs.hanzi: 他看见那张大嘴鱼，问塔维还想把它送进多少人的饭碗。帕沃替他答，说鱼自己想走，与作者无关。

pairs.target: dào chēxíng shí tiāngāngliàng , tǎ wéi huítóu wàng le yìyǎn , xuégōng shàngtóu de chuāng lǐ yǒurén zhèng juǎnqǐ liánzǐ .
pairs.english: It was just dawn at the transport office. Tavi looked back once: someone was rolling up a curtain in an upper academy window.
pairs.hanzi: 到车行时天刚亮，塔维回头望了一眼，学宫上头的窗里有人正卷起帘子。

pairs.target: mǐlā méi gēn dào zhèlǐ , pà wò yě dé qù páixì . tā méiyǒu shǎo le shuí tóngháng biàn juéde zhètànglù búsuànshù , bēibāo kào zài xī shàng , wàicéng yóubù de wèidào suíchē diān le yíxià , réng shì zuōfang lǐ nà gǔ shúxī de qìxī .
pairs.english: Mira hadn't followed here, and Pavo had rehearsal. Tavi didn't feel the journey counted less without them. His pack rested on his knees; a jolt released the outer oilcloth's familiar workshop smell.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉没跟到这里，帕沃也得去排戏。他没有少了谁同行便觉得这趟路不算数，背包靠在膝上，外层油布的味道随车颠了一下，仍是作坊里那股熟悉的气息。

pairs.target: lùshang yùjiàn yíduì xiū biāngōu de rén , xiān fàngguò le gōnglù chē , zài bǎ dǎng shuǐ de mùcáo táihuíqù .
pairs.english: On the road a ditch-repair crew let the public cart pass, then lifted the water-diverting wooden trough back into place.
pairs.hanzi: 路上遇见一队修边沟的人，先放过了公路车，再把挡水的木槽抬回去。

pairs.target: gǎnchē de rén děng zuìhòu yìzhī shǒu líkāi chēlún páng cái qǐ xíng , méi ná wǎn dào de shíchén màrén .
pairs.english: The driver waited for the last hand to leave the wheel's side before starting, without abusing anyone over the delay.
pairs.hanzi: 赶车的人等最后一只手离开车轮旁才起行，没拿晚到的时辰骂人。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng shuō zhè duàn qián liǎngrì hái shī , xiū dé mànxiē yǒu yuángù , suíhòu biàn bìyǎn kàozhe chē bì , búzài féng yíduànlù jiù wèn tǎ wéi kànchū le shénme .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng said this stretch was still wet two days earlier, explaining the slow repairs, then leaned against the cart wall and closed his eyes, no longer questioning Tavi about every stretch.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡说这段前两日还湿，修得慢些有缘故，随后便闭眼靠着车壁，不再逢一段路就问塔维看出了什么。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yě méiyǒu yìzhí fān tú . tā kàn shānyāoshàng yǒurén pù shài dòuzǐ , jǐzhī niǎo rào zhe rén zǒu , rén zhī tái yíxiàshǒu , niǎo fēi dào xià yíkuài shítou , réng bùkěn zǒu yuǎn .
pairs.english: Tavi wasn't always turning maps either. On the mountainside someone spread beans to dry; birds circled, flew to the next stone at a raised hand, and refused to go far.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维也没有一直翻图。他看山腰上有人铺晒豆子，几只鸟绕着人走，人只抬一下手，鸟飞到下一块石头，仍不肯走远。

pairs.target: dào le wǔ xiē chù , tā jǐ shuǐnáng tiānmǎn , xiǎngqǐ tèlún yào tiāo tiān hǎo de shíhòu chūmén , jīnrì dǎo ràng zìjǐ xiān zhàn le piányi .
pairs.english: At the midday stop he filled his water bag, remembering Teren's wish to go out in fine weather; today he'd got that advantage first.
pairs.hanzi: 到了午歇处，他给水囊添满，想起特伦要挑天好的时候出门，今日倒让自己先占了便宜。

pairs.target: tāmen yèlǐ réng zhù gōnglù shang de kèdiàn , cìrì xiàwǔ huídào fēng zhàn .
pairs.english: They again stayed at a roadside inn overnight and returned to Wind Trestle the next afternoon.
pairs.hanzi: 他们夜里仍住公路上的客店，次日下午回到风栈。

pairs.target: miànbāo pù de ménliǎn méi biàn , ménbiān què xīn diàoqǐ yíchuàn shàigān de yèzi , zǒujìn qù yào xiān cè yíxiàtóu .
pairs.english: The bakery frontage was unchanged, but a new string of dried leaves beside the door required ducking one's head to enter.
pairs.hanzi: 面包铺的门脸没变，门边却新吊起一串晒干的叶子，走进去要先侧一下头。

pairs.target: lóushàng de fángjiān gěi tāmen liú zhe , tǎ wéi tuī chuāng shí , yuǎnchù yìzhī kōng huòxiāng zhèngyán suǒdào wǎng shí bèi tuìhuí , gǔ lǐ xiān chuánlái lúnzǐ de shēngyīn , guò le yíhuìer cái kànqīng xiāng dǐ de yǐng .
pairs.english: Their upstairs rooms had been kept. As Tavi opened the window, an empty carriage returned along the cableway toward Shibei; wheel sounds reached him from the valley before he could distinguish the shadow beneath it.
pairs.hanzi: 楼上的房间给他们留着，塔维推窗时，远处一只空货厢正沿索道往石背退回，谷里先传来轮子的声音，过了一会儿才看清厢底的影。

pairs.target: dù chéng bǎ chǐcùn cè tāndào yuánlái de zhuōshàng , wèn huíxiào de rén yǒuméiyǒu bèi yāoqiú zài duō xiě shíběn .
pairs.english: Du Cheng spread the measurement book on its old table and asked whether the school visitors had been made to write ten more.
pairs.hanzi: 杜澄把尺寸册摊到原来的桌上，问回校的人有没有被要求再多写十本。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng shuō méiyǒu , dù chéng biàn shuō nà shì xuégōng méi tóng nǐ gòng guò shì .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng said no; Du Cheng said that meant the academy hadn't worked with him.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡说没有，杜澄便说那是学宫没同你共过事。

pairs.target: shuōwán cái bǎ xīn shōudào de zhàngyè ná chūlái , chēfū yúxià de děngdài fèi yǐjīng diàn qīng , liánhuì yě bǔ lái le xù pái liǎngzhōu de qián , míngcè réng gěi yuànyì de rén lún , xùnliàn lìngjì .
pairs.english: Then he produced the new account sheet: the driver's remaining waiting charge was advanced in full, and the association had funded two more weeks of the rota, still voluntary, with training counted separately.
pairs.hanzi: 说完才把新收到的账页拿出来，车夫余下的等待费已经垫清，联会也补来了续排两周的钱，名册仍给愿意的人轮，训练另计。

pairs.target: wēn xiù zài pángbiān de kòngdì shàng dā chū le dìèrzhī tuōjià de dǐ kuàng , mùliào hái lù zhe xīn páo de qiǎnsè .
pairs.english: Wenxiu had assembled the second cradle's base frame in the space beside them, its freshly planed wood still pale.
pairs.hanzi: 温岫在旁边的空地上搭出了第二只托架的底框，木料还露着新刨的浅色。

pairs.target: tā ràng tǎ wéi kàn , què búràng tā zhànjìnqù , shuō cháwán chǐcùn hé jiētóu , cái lún dào dì miànshì fàng , guò le nà yì guān hái dé kòngxiāng , xiàndìng qīngzǎi āicì lái .
pairs.english: She let Tavi look but not stand inside: dimensions and joints needed checking before ground rehearsals, then empty-crate and restricted light-load trials in sequence.
pairs.hanzi: 她让塔维看，却不让他站进去，说查完尺寸和接头，才轮到地面试放，过了那一关还得空箱、限定轻载挨次来。

pairs.target: shí bèi nà zhī réng liúzài yuánchù , xīn kuàng yě méiyǒu yīnwèi tā huílái jiù hūrán jiēshàng huò .
pairs.english: The Shibei cradle stayed where it was; the new frame hadn't suddenly begun handling freight because he'd returned.
pairs.hanzi: 石背那只仍留在原处，新框也没有因为他回来就忽然接上货。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ yánbiān jìshù de zhǐ jiāogěi tā , zìjǐ méiyǒu zhàn huí yuánxiān zhàn de wèizhì .
pairs.english: Tavi handed her the edge-measurement papers without reclaiming his old standing position.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把沿边记数的纸交给她，自己没有占回原先站的位置。

pairs.target: huànbān de rén yǐjīng zhīdào gāi zài nǎér kàn bù biān shìde jiēchù yìnhén , jì huái zhào zìjǐ de liǎngbān zuò wán , háiyào qù suàn xiàwǔ chāi xiāng de jiànshù .
pairs.english: The replacement crew already knew where to check the cloth-edge-like contact marks. Ji Huai finished his two shifts and still had the afternoon unpacking piecework to count.
pairs.hanzi: 换班的人已经知道该在哪儿看布边似的接触印痕，纪槐照自己的两班做完，还要去算下午拆箱的件数。

pairs.target: zhèlǐ zài tā bú zài shí yě zhàocháng guò le xǔduōtiān , yǒuxiē shì búyòng zài děng tā shuōmíng , fǎnér ràng tā xīnlǐ qīngkuài .
pairs.english: Life here had gone on during his absence. Some things no longer needed his explanation, and that lightened his heart.
pairs.hanzi: 这里在他不在时也照常过了许多天，有些事不用再等他说明，反而让他心里轻快。

pairs.target: bàngwǎn xià róng cóng wàitou huílái , xiān kànjiàn tā bāo shàng de yóubù , wèn chénglǐ shìbushì lián xiédài dōu gǎi dé nàme kuān .
pairs.english: That evening Xiarong returned, spotted the oilcloth on his bag, and asked whether even city shoelaces had become that wide.
pairs.hanzi: 傍晚夏绒从外头回来，先看见他包上的油布，问城里是不是连鞋带都改得那么宽。

pairs.target: tā bǎ liǎngzhǒng kuāndù hé jiàqián zhǎnkāi , tā jiāng zìjǐ de xié tídào dèng shàng bǐ , xuǎn le jiàozhǎi de yìzhǒng , juédìng xià tàng tuō jìnchéng de chēxíng dài .
pairs.english: He unfolded both widths and prices. She compared them against her shoe on a stool, chose the narrower kind, and decided to ask the transport firm to bring some on its next city trip.
pairs.hanzi: 他把两种宽度和价钱展开，她将自己的鞋提到凳上比，选了较窄的一种，决定下趟托进城的车行带。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō zìjǐ méi mǎi , tā shuō zhènghǎo , duō mǎi yífù bìng bùnéng jiào yìshuāng xié cháng chū gèng duōkǒng .
pairs.english: Tavi said he hadn't bought any. She said good: an extra pair of laces wouldn't make a pair of shoes grow extra holes.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说自己没买，她说正好，多买一副并不能叫一双鞋长出更多孔。

pairs.target: wǎnfàn qián tāmen tóng ruǎn héng bǎ yúxià de lùchéng zài kànyíbiàn : zài fēng zhàn liú dào hòu rì chūfā , wǎng nán zhù yíyè , tíqián yìtiān dào bái péng yì , děng yuē hǎo de huìhé .
pairs.english: Before dinner they reviewed the rest of the route with Ruan Heng: leave Wind Trestle the day after tomorrow, spend a night going south, and reach White Awning Station one day early for the meeting.
pairs.hanzi: 晚饭前他们同阮衡把余下的路程再看一遍：在风栈留到后日出发，往南住一夜，提前一天到白棚驿，等约好的会合。

pairs.target: nài lěi nàbiān shàngwú xīn de biàndòng xiāoxī , xuégōng jìchū dí quèrèn yě méi lìng huí yìfēng shōutiáo , tāmen biàn àn yuán yuē zǒu , yánlù dào yìzhàn zài wèn .
pairs.english: There was no new change from Nerai, nor a separate receipt for the academy's posted confirmation, so they would follow the original arrangement and ask at stations along the way.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾那边尚无新的变动消息，学宫寄出的确认也没另回一封收条，他们便按原约走，沿路到驿站再问。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng lán yú zhǐ fàngjìn bēibāo nèicéng , wàitou zhī liú huì chángyòng de chǐ hé zhǐ .
pairs.english: Tavi put the blue-fish paper inside his pack, leaving only the often-used ruler and paper outside.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将蓝鱼纸放进背包内层，外头只留会常用的尺和纸。

pairs.target: túbǎn bāo shàng yóubù , réng yǒu yìjiǎo méi guǒ yán . tā jiěkāi chóngdié , méiyǒu zài wǎng lǐ tiān dōngxī , xiān bǎ nà yìjiǎo liúchū de dìfāng lǐ píng .
pairs.english: The board was wrapped in oilcloth but one corner wasn't covered securely. He untied it and folded it again, adding nothing more, first smoothing the space left at that corner.
pairs.hanzi: 图板包上油布，仍有一角没裹严。他解开重叠，没有再往里添东西，先把那一角留出的地方理平。
